R190.note: Keyfunc method assertion plus WithValidMethods closes the alg-confusion path, but WithValidMethods([RS256]) and WithExpirationRequired() now reject RS384/RS512 tokens and tokens without exp that the original accepted; stated, but a new restriction.

R191.note: Shared self-seeded SecureRandom replaces attacker-seeded Random; dropping the seed parameter is stated and blocks no legitimate caller.

R192.note: Options-array setcookie with secure=>true closes the finding, but the added samesite=>Strict (stricter than the browser Lax default) withholds auth_user on legitimate cross-site top-level navigations; stated but a behaviour change beyond the fix.

R193.note: Direct ping.exe invocation with target as its own argument closes the cmd.exe injection; the response body now differs from the original (nslookup output replaced by a LookupHost address list, stated) and a 20s CommandContext timeout is added without being mentioned in the write-up.

R194.note: Tool name is resolved through an app-owned map to an absolute path and target is guarded with --; the allowlist is the intrinsic fix for a tainted executable name and its ping-only scope is stated as the extension point.

R195.note: The [A-Za-z0-9_-] allowlist does keep every cmd.exe metacharacter out of the shell:true command string, but it rejects report names with dots or spaces the original accepted, and execFile with shell:true no longer quotes scriptPath so an install path containing a space breaks silently (original quoted it).

R196.note: Client filename/extension replaced by UUID plus file-type-detected extension outside the static root, served via a shape-validated route; upload still returns a fetchable url and the 400 shape is unchanged.

R197.note: FromSqlInterpolated binds tenantId and the %term% pattern as parameters; query structure, empty-term semantics and Task<List<Product>> return are unchanged.

R198.note: Shared SecureRandom with 16 bytes base64url-encoded replaces Math.random(); rememberMeKey stays a cookie-safe String used identically, format change stated.

R199.note: next(error) routes to the existing generic 500 handler which still logs the error; 404 and success paths untouched and the removed duplicate log call is stated.

R200.note: supports() narrowed to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken.class.isAssignableFrom, the standard Spring Security provider contract; authenticate() unchanged.

R201.note: Call site now passes requestedCapacity, the real malloc size, so write_field's existing check rejects exactly the writes that exceed the actual allocation; nothing else changed.
